name.text: Saying Who or What It Is, and What It Means

description.text: 这一组句型帮助学习者先交代人物、事物或概念是什么，再补充它现在怎么样、来自哪里，或某个词具体指什么。
This group helps learners say who or what a person, thing, or idea is, then add its state, background, or meaning more clearly.
把主语和身份、状态连起来，说明「是什么 / 怎么样」。am / is / was / will be / going to be 合在这一格，因为合起来才是「是」的完整时体，整块记，不要拆成 will 和 be。例如 He is my brother. / It will be sunny tomorrow.

Links the subject to an identity or state. am / is / was / will be / going to be sit in one hole because together they are the linking verb’s full tense-aspect — remember the chunk, don’t split will from be. Example: He is my brother. / It will be sunny tomorrow.

categoryDescription.text: 用于控制 be、do、have、存在式或附加问句中的助动形式。
Controls auxiliary forms for be, do, have, existential frames, or tag questions.

description.text: 表示肯定、确认或直接陈述某事成立。
Marks a positive statement, confirmation, or direct assertion that something holds true.
说明「不是什么 / 不怎么样」。isn't / wasn't / won't be / not going to be 合在这一格，因为合起来才是否定「是」的完整时体，整块记。例如 This is not my pen. / This won't be easy.

Says it is not that identity or state. isn't / wasn't / won't be / not going to be sit in one hole because together they are the linking verb’s full tense-aspect — remember the chunk. Example: This is not my pen. / This won't be easy.

categoryDescription.text: 用于直接承载否定完整式、缩写与允许的否定 clitic。
Directly carries full negative forms, contractions, and allowed negative clitics.

description.text: 表示否定、不存在、不发生或不允许，常见于 not、never、no 等结构。
Marks negation, absence, non-occurrence, or prohibition, often signaled by not, never, or no.
表示整句话在说谁或什么，是那个被介绍、被描述、被判断、或去做事情的主体。
Shows who or what the sentence is about: the person, thing, or place being introduced, described, judged, or said to do something.

categoryDescription.text: 用于填入执行者、承受者或句子讨论对象等主语成分。
Used for the sentence subject, such as the doer, the affected entity, or the main topic under discussion.

description.text: 表示“是什么、属于哪一类、叫什么”的名词性内容。
Shows the noun phrase that says what something is, what kind it is, or what it is called.

categoryDescription.text: 用于填入完整名词短语，而不只是单个名词。
Used for a full noun phrase rather than only a single noun.

description.text: 表示动作或状态发生时的背景补充：常见为介词短语（地点、搭配、场景），也可为缩略的 V-ing 情状状语（如 entering Atlantic Daylight Time / walking home），不单独升成从句。

Background adjunct for an action or state: often a PP (place, company, setting), and also a reduced V-ing circumstance adjunct (e.g. entering Atlantic Daylight Time / walking home), kept inside the clause rather than promoted.

categoryDescription.text: 用于填入应整体保留的固定表达或高频搭配。
Used for fixed expressions or high-frequency chunks that should be treated as whole units.

description.text: 表示什么时候、持续多久、多久一次，或者先后顺序。
Shows when something happens, how long it lasts, how often it happens, or where it falls in a sequence.

categoryDescription.text: 用于填入表示时间点、时间段、频率或顺序的信息。
Used for information expressing time point, duration, frequency, or sequence.

description.text: 表示跟在 who、that、which、where 后面，用来继续说明前面名词的那句话。
Shows the clause that comes after who, that, which, or where to give more information about the noun before it.

categoryDescription.text: 用于填入完整从句，如原因从句、条件从句、宾语从句等。
Used for a full clause such as a reason clause, condition clause, or content clause.

description.text: 只包含一个独立分句的基础句型，是低阶教学和句型骨架训练的核心类型。
A sentence with only one independent clause, forming the core type for foundational teaching and sentence skeleton practice.
用于陈述事实、观点、状态或信息，是写作与说明中最基础、最常见的句子功能类型。
Used to state facts, ideas, states, or information; the most common functional sentence type in writing and explanation.
整个句型只包含一个核心子句，没有并列或从属扩展，是最基础的句型骨架。
The pattern contains only one core clause with no coordination or subordination, forming the most basic sentence skeleton.
用于陈述事实、推断或一般信息，是英语中最常见的语气。
Used to state facts, inferences, or general information; it is the most common mood in English.
主语执行动作，表达更直接，常用于清楚说明施事者。
The subject performs the action, giving a direct structure that clearly highlights the doer.
用于指出某人或某物是什么、是谁，常见于启蒙和基础描述写作。
Used to state what or who someone or something is, common in beginner description and introduction.
单独即可完成表达，不依赖上下文中的其他句子承担结构角色。
Completes its communicative work on its own without depending on surrounding sentences for a structural role.
用于补充事实、细节、特征或说明，支撑主题句。
Adds facts, details, features, or explanation to support the topic sentence.
用于对前一句做出回答、接受、拒绝或反馈。
Responds to the previous turn by answering, accepting, rejecting, or giving feedback.

teachingRealizations: They are my friends at school.
He was my brother at school this year.

description.text: 表示系动词后接名词性补语，常用于身份、类别和定义表达。
An SVC skeleton with a noun complement, often used for identity, category, and definition.
表示系动词后接名词性补语，常用于身份、类别和定义表达。
An SVC skeleton with a noun complement, often used for identity, category, and definition.
表示主语通过系动词连接到补语，用于说明身份、性质、状态或结果。
A subject-verb-complement skeleton in which a linking verb connects the subject to its complement.

patternName.text: 说明是谁 / 是什么
Say who or what it is

patternDescription.text: 用来给人或事物下身份：它是谁、是什么角色或什么东西。
Identifies someone or something — who they are or what it is.

description.text: 表示整句话在说谁或什么，是那个被介绍、被描述、被判断、或去做事情的主体。
Shows who or what the sentence is about: the person, thing, or place being introduced, described, judged, or said to do something.

categoryDescription.text: 用于填入执行者、承受者或句子讨论对象等主语成分。
Used for the sentence subject, such as the doer, the affected entity, or the main topic under discussion.

description.text: 把主语和身份、状态连起来，说明「是什么 / 怎么样」。am / is / was / will be / going to be 合在这一格，因为合起来才是「是」的完整时体，整块记，不要拆成 will 和 be。例如 He is my brother. / It will be sunny tomorrow.

Links the subject to an identity or state. am / is / was / will be / going to be sit in one hole because together they are the linking verb’s full tense-aspect — remember the chunk, don’t split will from be. Example: He is my brother. / It will be sunny tomorrow.
